scientific_integrity: The result is proved by a Schur-complement convex dual and irreducible Z-matrix arguments. Supplemental finite exact and numerical tests do not establish the universal theorem. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed-unit-spoke star networks, arbitrary strictly positive independent linear actuator prices and nonnegative unbounded diagonal pinning gains. Optimizes the smallest eigenvalue, not a spectral ratio, nonlinear synchronization or uncertain topology. Related semidefinite design is known; specialist prior analytic star results could affect publication priority.
title: Price-ordered pinning and exact rate allocation on star networks
